'''Ghoel''' was a [[Wol Cabasshite]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> [[Gender|male]] who resided in [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine]] during the period of the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> An adaptive being sometimes mistaken for a pest,<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> [[mollusk]]-like Ghoel often glued himself to the palace's walls and arches, and used his prehensile [[tongue]] to lick other occupants of the court.<ref name="Geektionary" /> He was present in the palace audience chamber in [[4 ABY]] when [[Luke Skywalker]] delivered a message to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> and later licked [[C-3PO]] as the [[protocol droid]] translated Jabba's condemnation of Skywalker and his [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] friends.<ref name="Geektionary" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ghoel appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> A prototype model of the character with a forked tongue was designed for the film.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> Epoxy was used on areas of the final costume to make it look wet.<ref name="Archeology">{{YouTube|video=RWw8-s_a0vM|text=Star Wars: Return of the Jedi - Cantina Archeology Part 3: Behind The Scenes of Jabba's Palace|channel=@CredibleNerds|name=The Credible Nerds}}</ref> The character was listed as number ten on list of creatures being made for the film from [[November 4]], [[1981]], which gave its production nicknames as "Low Clearance" and "Wol Cabasshite,"<ref name="Creature History">{{SW|url=news/return-of-the-jedi-creature-history-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=''Return of the Jedi'' Creature History with Pablo Hidalgo|nolive=1}}</ref> which would become the name of its species,<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> but also just referred to as "Slug."<ref name="Archeology" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified as Ghoel in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="VE" />
